manga_title: My Wife Is From a Thousand Years Ago 171
text:
Page 001
001-1. 1STKISSMANGA.ME
001-2. THERE'S SOMETHING I FORGOT TO MENTION.
001-3. THE THREE OF US ARE IN THE NEWS- PAPER.
001-4. WHAT THE HELL?! WHY DIDN'T ANYONE TELL ME?
001-5. I DIDN'T EXPECT THAT ONE DAY I WOULD BE IN THE NEWSPAPER...

Page 002
002-1. 1STKISSMANGA.ME
002-2. OH YEAH,I REMEMBER"YOU TWO SAYING THAT YOU'LL SEE MEON THE NEWS SOONER OR LATER, DIDNT ITCOME TRUE?
002-3. SHOO,WE WERE JUST SAYING THAT BACK THEN.
002-4. I'LL BE TAKING THIS NEWSPAPER TO FRAMEANDHANGIT IN MY DAD'SOFFICE FOR HIMTO LOOK AT EVERY DAY.
002-5. AMION THERE?!
002-6. ALL YOUDID WAS SCREAM THAT DAY, ALRIGHT?! JUST PAY ATTENTION TO THE ROAD AND KEEP ON DRIVING!
002-7. *PLEASEDO NOT TRY THIS
002-8. TSK, I WAS JUST CALLING FOR HELP. WHAT IF THE TWOOFYOU COULDN'TSTOPHIM;I WAS JUST BEING SAFE.BESIDES, I'MSO WEAK,IT WOULDVE BEEN GAMEOVERIFI WENT OVER AS WELL.
002-9. TO BE HONEST, I DIDN'TREGISTER WHAT HADACTUALLY HAPPENED,AND THOSETWOGUYSALREADYMADE THEIRMOVETHENHAOZISTARTED CLUTCHING HISSTOMACHAND BLEEDING.ITLOOKEDLIKE HE WAS GOING TO DIE.
002-10. HAOZI, I GOTTA SAY, YOURE REALLY PLAYING WITH YOUR LIFE. WHY DON'T YOU CHANGE JOBS AND DO LOGISTICS OR SOMETHING.
002-11. CHANGE MY ASS,I STILL WANT TO BE- COMEADE- TECTIVE!
002-12. DAMN, I REALLY CAN'TUNDERSTAND HOWA MUSCULAR GUY LIKEYOUTHINK.COULD IT BE THAT YOUR HEAD IS FULL OF MUSCLES?

Page 003
003-1. 1STKISSMANGA.ME
003-2. LET'SDOAN INTERVIEW, HONOR- ABLE COMRADEQIN HAO, HOW DO YOU FEELAFTERBEING HOSPITALIZEDFOR HALF A MONTH?
003-3. GREAT!
003-4. *ALTHOUGH THE ROAD DOESN'T HAVEOTHER CARS, PLEASEDONOTTRYTHIS. 吸嗅
003-5. FUCK!
003-6. DRIVE SAFER! OUCH,MY STOMACH!
003-7. HEH, WEREN'T YOU FEELING GREAT?
003-8. THISIS CALLED PAIN AND HAPPI- NESS!
003-9. IT'S NOT LIKE YOU TWO DON'TKNOW,I'M ALWAYSTHINKING ABOUT ENCOUNTERING SOMETHING AND THEN YELLING:"DONT MOVE!POLICE!"ALTHOUGH I DON'T HAVEA GUN, IT'S STILL SATISFYING.
003-10. NEEDLESSTO SAY, WHEN I SAW THAT GIRL COMING TO THANK ME, I FELTASENSEOF ACC OMPLISHMENTINMY HEART,IF IT WASN'T FOR ME..
003-11. AHEM~
003-12. IF IT WASN'T FOR US WALKING BY,NOT TO MENTION HER MONEY GETTING STOLEN,SHE COULD'VE ALSO SUFFERED SOME INJURIES.
003-13. YEAH,IF IT WASN'T FORME, YOU WOULD'VE DIED FOR YOUR BRAVERY.
003-14. GO TO HELL WITHYOUR COM- PLACENCY!
003-15. HEH,IF IT WASN'T FORME, YOU WOULDNT HAVE HAD THAT CHANCE TO SHOW OFF.
003-16. *WAITING AT A RED LIGHT 128888

Page 004
004-1. 1STKISSMANGA.ME
004-2. THAT'S TRUE, IF IT WASN'TFOR THIS GUY WANTING TOGO TOAN INTERNETCAFE, WE WOULDVE WENT BACKTOOUR RE- SPECTIVE HOMES AND NOTHING WOULD'VE HAPPENED,
004-3. SEE THAT, THE TWO OF YOU ARE AJINXTOGETHER AND WILL GET INTO TROLBLE. IT HAS NOTHING TO DO WITHME,YOUCAN CALL HIMNEXT TIMEYOUGO OUT FOR A WALK.
004-4. IT SEEMS THAT AS LONG AS THE THREE OF US ARE TOGETHER, WEWILL BEFINE.
004-5. IORGINALLY THOUGHTTHATMY JINXING MOUTH WOULD WORK WELL WITH QINGZI, BUTNOWITTURNSOUT THAT WANG ZIJUN IS THE BAD OMEN.
004-6. PTUI, DON'T SAY STUFF LIKE THAT,I'M DRIVING!YOU DON'T WANT TO GO BACK TO THE HOSPITAL WITH THE THREE OF US IN THE SAME ROOM, DO YOU?
004-7. THIS IS CALLED A REVERSE JINX, iT'S FOR YOUR SAFETY.
004-8. YOU CAN SHUTUP NOW!
004-9. I'MBACK.

Page 005
005-1. 1STKISSMANGA.ME
005-2. SWEEP AWAY ALLTHE BAD LUCK BEFORE ENTERING THE DOOR.
005-3. HOLY SHIT!
005-4. THESE PEOPLE GOT NOTHING BETTER TO DO,AND NOWTHEY AREPREPARING FOR WAR?!
005-5. ONCE I'M FINISHED, YOU CAN WEAR THIS ON DUTY.LET'S SEE WHO CAN HURT YOU NOW.
005-6. I'M ABOUT TO FINISH TOO, LET'S SEE WHO IT FINISHES FIRST!
005-7. HMPH, I WON'T LOSE!

Page 006
006-1. 1STKISSMANGA.ME
006-2. I'MA LITTLE SLEEPY,SOI'M GOINGTO MY ROOM TO REST, YOU GUYS CAN IDIDN'TSLEEP DO WHATEVER. WEL LAST NIGHT
006-3. ALRIGHT, WE'LL BE TAKING OUR LEAVE, YOU CAN REST.
006-4. YOU CAN LEAVE FIRST,WANGZI. I'LL TAKE THIS CHANCE TO SEE MYPARENTS.
006-5. OH, SURE.

Page 007
007-1. ISTKISSMANGA.ME
007-2. MOM,I'M BACK.
007-3. IT'S JUST YOU? WHERE'S JIANG HE?
007-4. IT'S JUST MEI CAME TO VISIT SINCE IT WAS ALONG THE WAY.
007-5. WHERE'S DAD?
007-6. HE'S WRITING SOMETHINGIN HISOFFICE.
007-7. DAD!
007-8. WHATARE YOU DOING HERE?
007-9. SMILINGLIKE A MOUSE, HE'S DEFINITELYUP TO NO GOOD.
007-10. LOOK AT THIS!

Page 008
008-1. 1STKISSMANGA.ME
008-2. WHAT IS THIS?
008-3. I'MBACK~

Page 009
009-1. 1STKISSMANGA.ME
009-2. WHY ARE YOU CARRYING A GOOSE?!
009-3. COULD IT BE THAT...
009-4. SHE DIDN'T CATCH A FISH, SO SHE BROUGHT BACK SOMEONE'SGOOSE INSTEAD?!
